visual_action: The video is a montage set at an American football game. It opens with wide shots of a crowded stadium, with an American flag displayed on the field. A plane resembling Air Force One performs a flyover. A black presidential SUV arrives. Donald Trump exits the vehicle, shakes hands with a man, and they converse. The video cuts between clips of the football game (Washington Commanders vs. Detroit Lions) and scenes of Trump's visit. Trump is presented with a customized football reading "PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP" and a framed jersey with "TRUMP 47". He is shown clapping and smiling in a suite, and his image appears on the stadium's Jumbotron, to which some fans react with thumbs-ups. A large group of people on the field take an oath with their right hands raised. Trump is also shown in a broadcast booth with a FOX Sports microphone, speaking with two other men. The video concludes with black-and-white footage of the White House.
